author: Digital Foundry
description:
Content sponsored by Secret Mode. In a massive Digital Foundry deep dive, we go behind the scenes at Fuse Games to discuss the vision and ambition behind STAR WARS: Galactic Racer. The development team discuss the origins of the studio, the journey from pitch to production, why they chose Unreal Engine 5 and how they got the most out of the Epic engine across in delivering a signature experience that runs at a locked 60 frames per second on consoles.

00:00 – Introduction: Reviving Arcade Racing
02:18 – Studio Origins & The Core Vision
06:26 – Consequence & Run-Based Campaign Structure
09:17 – Unreal Engine 5 & Fast Prototyping
13:07 – Performance Target: 60 FPS or Nothing
15:45 – Lighting & Optimisation: Hardware Lumen vs Lightmass
19:01 – Physics, Profiling & In-House Tools (Trace Analyser & Conductor)
21:11 – Blueprints to C++ & Image Quality (TSR)
24:01 – Track Design: Handcrafted Racetracks vs. Open Worlds
26:07 – Vehicle Physics, Handling & Repulsor Height-Matching
28:02 – Desig
title: Inside STAR WARS: Galactic Racer: The Tech Behind The Big Arcade Racing Revival [Sponsored]
